en: 10. The Pairs on the Faculties (Indriyayamaka) 10.1 Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāra) 10.1.2 Exposition of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāraniddesa)
10.1.2.1. Chapter on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanavāra) 10.1.2.1.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma):
Is the eye the eye-faculty?
The divine eye, the wisdom-eye, and the physical eye are not the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*). The eye-faculty is both the eye and the eye-faculty.
Is the eye-faculty the eye? Yes.
Is the ear the ear-faculty?
The divine ear is the stream of craving, not the ear faculty. The ear faculty is both the ear and the ear faculty.
Is the ear faculty the ear? Yes.
Is the nose the nose faculty? Yes.
Is the nose-faculty the nose? Yes.
Is the tongue the tongue-faculty? Yes.
Is the tongue-faculty the tongue? Yes.
Is the body the body-faculty?
With the exception of the body-faculty, the remainder is the body, but not the body-faculty. The body-faculty is both the body and the body-faculty.
Is the body-faculty the body? Yes.
Is the mind the mind-faculty? Yes.
Is the mind-faculty the mind? Yes.
Is a woman the female-faculty? No.
Is the female faculty (itthindriya) the woman?
No. Is the male person the male faculty (purisindriya)? No. Is the male faculty the male person? No.
Is life the life-faculty? Yes. Is the life-faculty life? Yes.
Is pleasure the pleasure-faculty? Yes.
Is the faculty of pleasure pleasure? Yes.
Is suffering the faculty of pain? Yes.
Is the faculty of pain suffering? Yes.
Is mental joy the faculty of mental joy? Yes.
Is the faculty of mental joy mental joy? Yes.
Is mental grief the faculty of mental grief? Yes.
Is the faculty of displeasure (domanassindriya) displeasure (domanassa)? Yes.
Is equanimity (upekkhā) the faculty of equanimity (upekkhindriya)?
With the exception of the faculty of equanimity, all remaining equanimity is not the faculty of equanimity. The faculty of equanimity is both equanimity and the faculty of equanimity.
Is the faculty of equanimity equanimity? Yes.
Is faith the faculty of faith? Yes. Is the faculty of faith faith? Yes.
Is energy the faculty of energy? Yes. Is the faculty of energy energy? Yes.
Is mindfulness the faculty of mindfulness? Yes.
Is the faculty of mindfulness mindfulness? Yes.
Is concentration the faculty of concentration? Yes.
Is the faculty of concentration concentration? Yes.
Is wisdom the faculty of wisdom? Yes.
Is the faculty of wisdom wisdom? Yes.
Is "I shall come to know the unknown" the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown"? Yes.
Is the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown" (anaññātaññassāmītindriya) the state of "I shall come to know the unknown"? Yes.
Is the faculty of final knowledge (aññindriya) final knowledge (añña)? Yes. Is final knowledge the faculty of final knowledge? Yes.
Is one who has fully known [the truth] (aññātāvī) the faculty of one who has fully known (aññātāvindriya)? Yes.
Is the faculty of one who has fully known one who has fully known [the truth]? Yes. 10.1.2.1.2.
Negative (Paccanīka).
Is it not the eye, yet not the eye-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the eye-faculty, yet not the eye?
The divine eye and the wisdom-eye are not the eye-faculty, but they are the eye. Excluding both the eye and the eye-faculty, the remainder is neither the eye nor the eye-faculty.
Is it not the ear, yet not the ear-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the ear-faculty, yet not the ear?
The divine ear and the stream of craving are not the ear-faculty, but they are the ear. Excluding both the ear and the ear-faculty, the remainder is neither the ear nor the ear-faculty.
Is it not the nose, yet not the nose-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the nose-faculty, yet not the nose? Yes.
Is it not the tongue, yet not the tongue-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not the tongue-faculty is not the tongue? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not the body is not the body-faculty? Yes. Is it not the case that what is not the body-faculty is not the body? Yes.

Excluding the body-faculty (*kāyindriya*), the remainder is not the body-faculty, but it is the body (*kāya*). Excluding both the body and the body-faculty, the remainder is neither the body nor the body-faculty.
Is it not the mind (*mano*) and not the mind-faculty (*manindriya*)? Yes. Is it not the mind-faculty and not the mind? Yes.
Is it not a woman, yet not the female faculty?
The female faculty is not a woman; it is the female faculty. Excluding both the woman and the female faculty, the remainder is neither a woman nor the female faculty.
Is it not the female faculty, yet not a woman?
A woman is not the female faculty; she is a woman. Excluding both the woman and the female faculty, the remainder is neither a woman nor the female faculty.

Is it not the case that one who is neither a man nor the male faculty [is neither a man nor the male faculty]? The male faculty is not a man; it is the male faculty. Excluding both the man and the male faculty, the remainder is neither a man nor the male faculty.
Is it not the male faculty, yet not a male?
A male is not the male faculty; he is a male. Excluding both the male and the male faculty, the remainder are neither male nor the male faculty.
Is it not life, yet not the life-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the case that the life-faculty is not life? Yes.
Is it not the case that pleasure is not the pleasure-faculty? Yes.
Is it not the case that the pleasure-faculty is not pleasure? Yes.
Is it not suffering, yet not the faculty of suffering? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of suffering, yet not suffering? Yes.
Is it not mental joy, yet not the faculty of mental joy? Yes.

Is it not the case that what is not mental grief is not the faculty of mental grief? Yes.
Is it not the case that what is not the faculty of mental grief is not mental grief? Yes.
Is it not equanimity, yet not the faculty of equanimity? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of equanimity, yet not equanimity?

With the exception of the faculty of equanimity, the remainder are not the faculty of equanimity, but are equanimity. With the exception of both equanimity and the faculty of equanimity, the remainder are neither equanimity nor the faculty of equanimity.
Is it not faith, yet not the faculty of faith? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of faith, yet not faith? Yes.
Is it not energy, yet not the faculty of energy? Yes.
Is it not the case that the faculty of energy is not energy? Yes.
Is it not the case that mindfulness is not the faculty of mindfulness? Yes.
Is it not the case that the faculty of mindfulness is not mindfulness? Yes.
Is it not concentration and not the faculty of concentration? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of concentration and not concentration? Yes.
Is it not wisdom and not the faculty of wisdom? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of wisdom (paññindriya) and yet not wisdom (paññā)? Yes.
Is it not "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" (anaññātaññassāmīti) and yet not the faculty of "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" (anaññātaññassāmītindriya)? Yes.
Is it not the faculty of "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" and yet not "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown"? Yes.
Is it not "final knowledge" (aññā) that is not the "faculty of final knowledge" (aññindriya)? Yes.
Is it not the "faculty of final knowledge" that is not "final knowledge"? Yes.
Is it not the "one who has final knowledge" (aññātāvī) that is not the "faculty of one who has final knowledge" (aññātāvindriya)? Yes.
Is it not that the faculty of one who has already known is not "one who has already known"? Yes, it is. 10.1.2.2.
